name: National Movement in India - Partition and Independence: 1939-1947
overview: The Congress won 26 out of the 58 Muslim seats it had contested. Congress party had never accepted the “two-nation theory”. The Congress was unable to fulfill the demands of M A Jinnah, leader of the Muslim League.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The Congress won 26 out of the 58 _____ seats it had contested.
vsaq.answer: The Congress won 26 out of the 58 Muslim seats it had contested.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: _____ party had never accepted the “two-nation theory”.
vsaq.answer: Congress party had never accepted the “two-nation theory”.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: As the _____ were going to withdraw from India, these princely states were going to become independent.
vsaq.answer: As the British were going to withdraw from India, these princely states were going to become independent.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Around 1.5 crore people, both _____ and Muslims, were displaced.
vsaq.answer: Around 1.5 crore people, both Hindus and Muslims, were displaced.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Integration of various princely states into the new Indian _____ was a challenging task.
vsaq.answer: Integration of various princely states into the new Indian nation was a challenging task.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: They were asked to decide if they wanted to join _____, Pakistan or remain independent.
vsaq.answer: They were asked to decide if they wanted to join India, Pakistan or remain independent.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: According to this, _____ could hold elections and winning parties could form governments.
vsaq.answer: According to this, provinces could hold elections and winning parties could form governments.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Something tells me _____ was more willing to help Indians get their freedom.
vsaq.answer: Something tells me party was more willing to help Indians get their freedom.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: For example, many of the INA soldiers who were being tried for treason were _____, yet the people’s anger and sympathy gave no thought to the religion of the soldiers.
vsaq.answer: For example, many of the INA soldiers who were being tried for treason were Muslims, yet the people’s anger and sympathy gave no thought to the religion of the soldiers.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: By 1941, Japan had _____ expanding into South East Asia.
vsaq.answer: By 1941, Japan had started expanding into South East Asia.
